notes: Page states these styles apply to all LSB Industries brands; the ClimaCool, ClimateCraft and ClimateMaster pages carry identical style text and the same chart images, so the shared system is source-established. This file carries the styles in full rather than usesStylesOf, so it stands alone. Only page Style 2 ships, year-only: its year digits are text-verified while its month letter mapping is chart-only. Page Style 1 is HELD, not shipped: its year is a single letter whose mapping is chart-only (CLIMATEMASTER-1-Serial-Number.jpg) and its week-position text is ambiguous (3rd & 4th digits could count characters or numerical digits only), so neither its year nor its week is encoded. Image-pass items: both LSB chart images (see report).

styles.notes: Page 1-based positions 1-2 = year digits, converted to 0-based half-open [0,2]; 92 resolves to 1992 under the century rule (2092 is future). Month is the 3rd character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image CLIMATEMASTER-2-Serial-Number.jpg, so month is null and the style ships year-only per established precedent.
